race.description: Nsw Country Rugby Union Cockatoos (Bm66) Hcp
race.comment: OCEAN TSUNAMI (6) has a host of gear changes for this and is ready to win on a firmer surface. Tried hard with the 60.5kg when she stalked the speed to finish fourth at this track and trip. Senior rider hops aboard and expected to go close with the 57.5kg. FEAZABEEL (3) has gone to a new level this prep and looks to have more to offer fourth-up. Proved the Maiden win was no fluke with a fast-finishing neck win over 1600m at Goulburn as fav. Sure to go well again with Alysha Collett retaining the ride. SEBILLA (4) comes back in trip after she was collared late when sitting on the pace for a respectable third over 2200m at Newcastle in BM64 grade. Maps well and has a good record on her home track. KAHRABA (8) has strengthened over the break and no shock to see her win this third-up. Kept finding on the heavy (9) surface with a tenacious second over 1600m at Gosford in BM68 class. Near her top and this trip suits. Each-way.
